senses.gloss: m. (בדד) single stalk, twig; also (b. h.) pole, bar.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 44b:4">Succ. 44ᵇ</cite> even one leaf <he>וב׳ אחד</he> and (on) one twig.
B. Mets. 24ᵃ anything on which something is suspended ב׳ קרו ליה is called bad.—Pl. בַּדִּים.

Y. Yoma V, 42ᵇ bot., a. e. בין הב׳ between the bars projecting from the Ark (i.e. their corresponding place in the Second Temple). B. Mets. l. c. בַּדֵּי מחטין וכ׳ poles of peddlars for needles &c. Ib. מאי בדי what does baddé mean? Answ. Twigs.—And why do they call them baddé? Answ., v. supra. V. אַנְפּוֹרְיָא.
